02

Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
synthesis

Heat the DMSO-d₆ sample and acquire the NMR time series

Dissolve the reported precursor charge in DMSO-d6 and heat at 50 °C. Acquire NMR spectra every 60 min over 12 h. Species appearance and disappearance are observations, not recipe inputs. Missing fields for this phase: tube atmosphere, heating hardware. C2: Main p3 prints12mg,0.003mmol for both NMR and THF controls.448.92g/mol gives0.02673mmol. No silent tenfold correction. C6: Main p5 describes thiourea after2h; SI S2/S3 captions say1h. No single corrected onset inferred; chart/photo retained.

workup

Recover the yellow solid and prepare the XRD specimen

Separate the bright-yellow solid by benchtop centrifugation, wash it three times with toluene, and deposit it on an unspecified XRD substrate. The speed, time and drying details are not reported. Missing fields for this phase: centrifuge rpm/time, drying.
